value: Apparel, Piece Goods, and Notions Merchant Wholesalers

This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of footwear of leather, rubber, and other materials, including athletic footwear (except specialty athletic footwear).
Athletic footwear (except specialty athletic footwear) merchant wholesalers
Boots (e.g., hiking, western, work) merchant wholesalers
Leather cut stock for shoe and boot merchant wholesalers
